items.raw_excerpt: Jogadoras desfilarão em carro aberto pela Esplanada dos Ministérios.
items.summary_en: Brazil's Independence Day parade in Brasília will celebrate women's football pioneers. Players will ride in open cars along the Esplanade of Ministries. The tribute highlights the growth of the women's game in the country.

items.raw_excerpt: Moradora de Tocantinópolis, Maria de Fátima pegou uma van até Araguaína (TO), a mais de duas horas de distância de casa, madrugou na rodoviária para cedinho encarar mais mil quilômetros até a capital do país
items.summary_en: Maria de Fátima from Tocantinópolis took a van more than two hours to Araguaína. She woke before dawn at the bus station to begin a thousand-kilometer journey to the capital. Thousands of Brazilians traveled long distances to watch the national parade.

items.raw_excerpt: Tamil Nadu plans to streamline registration services with 25 model hubs and a presence-less system for greater accessibility.

items.raw_excerpt: The health minister was speaking about the job market to students and academic staff members at the annual Kent Ridge Ministerial Forum.
items.summary_en: Singapore's Health Minister Ong Ye Kung spoke about AI's impact on jobs at the annual Kent Ridge Ministerial Forum. He said AI can replace certain tasks but cannot take over entire jobs. The forum was held for students and academic staff at the National University of Singapore.
items.summary_ko: 싱가포르 보건부 장관 옹예꿍은 연례 켄트리지 장관 포럼에서 AI가 전체 일자리는 대체하지 못하고 특정 업무만 수행할 수 있다고 강조했습니다. 국립싱가포르대 학생과 교직원을 대상으로 한 이번 강연에서 그는 AI 기술 변화에 대한 노동시장의 대응 방향을 설명했습니다.

items.title_original: AI replacing certain tasks, but not entire jobs: Ong Ye Kung

items.raw_excerpt: From skiing and seafood to coastal hikes and cobblestone streets, these 9 pretty New England towns are small but mighty and well worth the trip.

items.raw_excerpt: Pendant tout un week-end, HEAT se pare de bleu et propose une programmation entre apéro, musique, jeux et souvenirs de vacances. Bref, tout ce qu’il faut pour
items.summary_en: A venue called HEAT in Lyon decorates everything in blue and turns into a big village square for one weekend. Visitors can enjoy drinks, music, games, and summer holiday memories together. It is a fun local event to celebrate the last days of summer.

items.raw_excerpt: Eleven years ago, Asdee was downgraded from the status of village to a node development because of population decline.
items.summary_en: Eleven years ago, the small village of Asdee in North Kerry was downgraded to a node development because its population shrank. But the community refused to give up and worked hard to rebuild. Now Asdee is internationally praised and encourages other small communities to keep going.

items.raw_excerpt: Sweden isn't only holding national elections on September 13th, but regional and municipal ones too. Here's what you need to know about the issues in the Stockholm elections.

items.raw_excerpt: Danish citizenship policy is often discussed in terms of legal requirements and parliamentary procedures. But behind these procedures are individuals directly affected by how the process unfolds. Contributor Naqeeb Khan tells the story of one of them.
items.summary_en: Denmark cancelled a citizenship bill that many people were counting on. An opinion piece shares the stories of individuals directly affected by this political decision. The article shows the human side behind legal and parliamentary procedures.

items.raw_excerpt: Many Americans in Germany have received letters from their US banks warning them that they may have to close their accounts due to a new EU banking requirements. We asked specialists in financial planning and tax to explain the implications.
items.summary_en: Many Americans living in Germany received letters from their US banks. The banks said they might have to close accounts because of new EU banking rules. Financial experts explain what this means for American expats.

items.raw_excerpt: Knowing how to speak Verlan - France's back-to-front language - doesn't mean you should do it as a foreigner, at least according to one French-language expert.
items.summary_en: A French language expert says foreigners should not use Verlan, France's backwards slang language. Verlan is when French words are said backwards as street slang. Even if you can say it, the expert thinks it is not right for outsiders to use.
